author: Vitor
notes: Simple BFS, only revisiting cells when reaching them with more health than previously.
aiExplanation: This function performs a **BFS (breadth-first search)** from the top-left corner to the bottom-right corner of the `grid`, tracking remaining `health` as it moves through each cell; whenever it steps onto a cell containing `1`, it loses one point of health, and if health hits `0` that path is abandoned. It processes the grid **level by level** (using a `stack`/`next` array as the current BFS frontier) and uses a `seen` matrix to prune revisits — a cell is only revisited if the new path reaches it with **more health** than a previous visit (`seen[r][c] >= hp` skips it). As soon as it reaches the bottom-right cell (`r === m - 1 && c === n - 1`) with health remaining, it returns `true`; if the frontier empties out without reaching the destination, it returns `false`.
